goal: Phase 2b process (docs/intent-factory/TECH-SPEC-2026-09-05-lean.md, revision 5, section 3 rules 4, 5 and 6, section 5 rows 2b). One controller with an atomic lock and files as state: lock.mjs replaces the supervisor lease, generations and lease-liveness; status.json per run and .runs/status.json are derived each tick; notifications go straight to INTENT_FACTORY_NOTIFY_BIN with receipts and bounded retry in notify.jsonl; heartbeat, liveness journal, outbox, cursors, projector and campaign autonomy are deleted after metrics, dashboard and the status line read the new records; campaign sync/ack key on journal event ids. Runtimes: claude-sonnet-5 workers with gate none, because DeepSeek (the only other admitted vendor) has no balance and a same-vendor judge is forbidden; the full suite and the orchestrator's diff review are the gate. Take 2: controller-lock landed at 0f7c9cd (adopted by the orchestrator after the first non-empty seal of the campaign exposed a defect in sealAttempt, fixed in the same commit range); this take carries the two remaining nodes.

definitionOfDone.text: The controller writes <run-dir>/status.json (run id, contract id, campaign id, controller pid and start time, nodes with state, attempt, runtime, elapsed, tokens by kind and cost from usage.jsonl, verdict, one-line note, needs-you items with the command that resolves each) and .runs/status.json (pointer to the active run plus the same summary) atomically on every tick and on every terminal transition; status, the status line and the dashboard read those files; observable in render.mjs, statusline/claude-code.sh, dashboard/dashboard.mjs and their tests.

On node.terminal, run.terminal and attention the controller calls INTENT_FACTORY_NOTIFY_BIN once with a one-line message rendered from fixed templates (counters and identifiers only, never model text) and appends a receipt {eventId, type, at, delivered|failed, attempts, error} to <run-dir>/notify.jsonl; a failed delivery is retried on the next ticks up to three times with backoff and then recorded failed; when the variable is unset nothing is spawned and the receipt says no_transport; progress never notifies; observable in scripts/notify/index.mjs and named tests for delivered, failed-after-three, and no-transport.

heartbeat.mjs, the liveness journal facts, outbox.mjs, events.mjs (the projector), notification cursors, campaign-autonomy.mjs with plan.json, control-state.json and the campaign start/supervise/configure/drain CLI commands are deleted with their tests and references after metrics.mjs, dashboard.mjs and the status line were switched to status.json, usage.jsonl and notify.jsonl; campaign sync and ack key on journal event ids; campaign watch --wake prints one line per actionable change (run terminal, node attention, orphaned run, twenty minutes without an active run) by reading status.json files, and nothing for progress; observable in the deleted files, campaign.mjs, campaign-cli.mjs and their tests.

taskPacket.objective: Derive status.json each tick, notify directly with receipts and bounded retry, and delete the heartbeat, outbox, projector and campaign-autonomy machinery after its readers moved to the new files.
instructions: Before you declare the work done, run every command proof in this node's Definition of Done — `npm run check` and `npm run typecheck` — in the foreground and fix what they report. The controller runs them again at the gate and a failure there costs the whole attempt. Your worker result lists at most 32 changedFiles (the protocol rejects a longer list and discards the attempt): when the diff touches more files, name directories or the most important paths and say so in the summary.

Never start a command in the background or through a task tool, and never wait on one with a sleep loop: the tool policy denies background Bash and the controller reads silence as a stall. Bound output with | tail -n 200. You are a headless session: ending your turn ends the session, nobody resumes you, and a missing canonical result file discards the attempt — never 'pause to wait'; run every command in the foreground with an explicit tool timeout (the Bash tool's timeout parameter, up to 600000 ms) and keep each command under eight minutes: runner.test.mjs only through the name-pattern splits `^r`, `^a`, `^[b-oB-O]`, `^[p-zP-Z]`, never the whole file in one command. Never run npm install, npm ci or any package install: the worktree has no node_modules by design (tsc is global), and the husky prepare hook would write .husky/_/.gitignore and fail the node's snapshot-integrity check.

The controller verifies this node with the full suite in five parts — runner.test.mjs split by test-name pattern `^r`, `^a`, `^[b-oB-O]` and `^[p-zP-Z]` so each part fits the 600 s verification ceiling (a two-way split of the non-a/r tests overran it on 2026-09-08), then skills/mine/intent-factory/test/*.mjs — and a failed verification discards the attempt, so run the same five commands yourself before finishing, each in the foreground with an explicit timeout: `node --test --test-name-pattern='^r' skills/mine/intent-factory/scripts/runner.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -n 80`, the same with `'^a'`, `'^[b-oB-O]'` and `'^[p-zP-Z]'`, then `node --test 'skills/mine/intent-factory/test/*.mjs' 2>&1 | tail -n 80`. The repository-level test/*.mjs suite (ci-policy) needs node_modules for commitlint and is run by the orchestrator at phase close, not here.

Read docs/intent-factory/TECH-SPEC-2026-09-05-lean.md section 3 rules 5 and 6, the module table (notify/* ≤ 200 lines, campaign.mjs ≤ 500) and the 'Deleted' paragraph, and section 5 row 2b status-and-notify before editing. Phase 2a closed at ad0a8a0 and the 2b controller-lock node landed at 0f7c9cd on 2026-09-08 (the HEAD of your worktree): scripts/lock.mjs holds the atomic controller lock with capture-and-verify takeover, supervisor.mjs, lease-liveness.mjs, the supervise command and the lease fields are gone, children run in their own process groups and resume's recovery pass reaps or adopts them (see references/operations.md 'Controller lock and takeover'); schema 3 (no ceilings, no progressPolicy, no capsule, no rotation, no handoff CLI), usage.jsonl per run written by appendUsageRecord in runner.mjs and read by render.mjs and metrics.mjs; full suite green in the installed checkout (547 tests, 545 pass, 0 fail, 2 skipped, 731 s); `npm run check` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Sizes at HEAD (lines): scripts/runner.mjs 5900, scripts/supervisor.mjs 694, scripts/lease-liveness.mjs 323, scripts/heartbeat.mjs 473, scripts/outbox.mjs 435, scripts/events.mjs 495, scripts/campaign-autonomy.mjs 1265, scripts/campaign.mjs 1309, scripts/campaign-cli.mjs 540, scripts/render.mjs 422, scripts/metrics.mjs 544, scripts/store.mjs 717, scripts/worktree.mjs 155, scripts/integrate.mjs 478, scripts/notify/index.mjs 125, dashboard/dashboard.mjs 617, statusline/claude-code.sh 413, scripts/runner.test.mjs 5245. Still present and yours to delete or replace in this phase where the packet says so: heartbeat.mjs (liveness journal facts, heartbeat.json, governance-metrics.json), outbox.mjs (notification-outbox.json, cursors, drain), events.mjs (projector), campaign-autonomy.mjs (plan.json, control-state.json, controller snapshots, repair synthesis). test/helpers.mjs defaults INTENT_FACTORY_NOTIFY_BIN to a no-op transport at import; tests that need undelivered or failing deliveries set a failing transport explicitly.

Order of work, because every deletion must leave a working product: first write status.json (per run and .runs/status.json, atomic rename, ≤ 200 KB) and notify.jsonl from the controller tick — the controller line comes from controller.lock (pid, start token, startedAt) which lock.mjs already exposes; then switch the readers — render.mjs status/report, statusline/claude-code.sh, dashboard/dashboard.mjs, metrics.mjs and metrics-report.mjs — to status.json, usage.jsonl and notify.jsonl; then delete heartbeat.mjs, the liveness journal facts and governance-metrics.json, outbox.mjs, events.mjs, notification cursors and the projector, campaign-autonomy.mjs with plan.json, control-state.json, controller snapshots and the campaign start/supervise/configure/drain commands, and every test of that machinery; then rewrite campaign sync and ack to key on journal event ids. Delete references/release-1.md, references/campaign-autonomy.md, references/feedback.md and references/harness-feedback.md when nothing they describe exists any more and fold the surviving two paragraphs (notify bin contract, status.json shape) into operations.md; remove their SKILL.md router rows and keep SKILL.md under the byte ceiling.

Notify. scripts/notify/index.mjs becomes a one-line dispatcher: render(event) from fixed per-type templates using counters and identifiers only (node id, run id, state, attempt, error code, done/total), call INTENT_FACTORY_NOTIFY_BIN with the JSON event on stdin, append the receipt to <run-dir>/notify.jsonl, and schedule up to three retries with backoff on failure from the controller tick. Keep the macOS osascript adapter only as an explicit opt-in (INTENT_FACTORY_NOTIFY_BIN=os-macos), never as a default: the default with no variable is no transport, recorded as such, because the implicit fallback spammed the owner's desktop from the test suite.

campaign watch --wake <id> reads the campaign's linked runs' status.json files every 30 s and prints exactly one line per actionable change — run terminal, node attention (failed, exhausted, stalled, canceled, blocked for a reason other than a failed dependency), a non-terminal run whose controller lock is stale, and twenty minutes with no active run — and exits when the campaign is closed; nothing for progress. It replaces .runs/control/intent-factory-lean-20260905/watch-campaign.mjs, which you may read for the exact conditions but must not edit.

Tests, each named after its case: status.json written on tick and on terminal with the documented shape; .runs/status.json points at the active run; notify delivered receipt, failed-after-three receipt, no-transport receipt, progress never notifies; campaign sync/ack by journal event id; watch --wake emits one line per actionable change and none for progress; metrics and dashboard read the new files; no test or module references heartbeat, outbox, events.mjs, campaign-autonomy or the liveness journal any more.

Keep your context small: read by offset or grep, never whole large files. Do not modify .runs/control or .runs/campaigns and do not commit. Writing the canonical result file the controller designates is required.
decisions: status.json per run and .runs/status.json are the only derived read surfaces; heartbeat, outbox and projector go.
Notifications are direct calls to INTENT_FACTORY_NOTIFY_BIN with receipts and three bounded retries; no transport means a recorded no_transport receipt, never an implicit desktop adapter.
Campaign autonomy (plan, control-state, supervise, repair synthesis) is deleted; the orchestrator session acts on watch --wake lines.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the dashboard page or the status line layout; phase 3 does that.

definitionOfDone.text: When a node is re-dispatched as attempt N+1 — after a gate rejection, a failed verification, a timeout, a stall, a cancel or a resume — its worktree and branch are cut from attempt N's sealed sha whenever attempt N left a sealed non-empty diff, so the worker continues its own work with the previous error and findings appended; only when attempt N sealed nothing does attempt N+1 start from the integration head; the recorded worktree.baseSha and the 'Previous attempt' section say which; observable in the retry dispatch, worktree.mjs and named replay tests for both cases.

The integration transaction is untouched: the accepted candidate is still integration-head plus the attempt branch, verified on the candidate ref before the run ref moves, and a continued attempt's branch is cut from the sealed sha, which is itself a descendant of the integration head at the time of attempt N; observable in integrate.mjs unchanged and the existing integration tests green.
An attempt worktree created from a repository that has node_modules receives a symlink to it, excluded from the workspace snapshot; observable in worktree.mjs and a named test.

Behaviour. In the retry dispatch (the path that creates attempt N+1's worktree for gate rejections, failed verification, timeout, stall, cancel and resume), seal attempt N first (sealAttempt in worktree.mjs already commits uncommitted edits onto the attempt branch and returns {sha, empty}); when the seal is non-empty, create attempt N+1's branch and worktree from that sealed sha and record worktree.baseSha = sealed sha and previousAttempt = N on the node; when it is empty, cut from the integration head as today. The 'Previous attempt' prompt section states which base was used and carries the previous error and findings. A rotation no longer exists after phase 2a; do not add one back.

Integration stays as it is: the accepted candidate is integration-head plus the attempt branch (fast-forward or merge), verified on the candidate ref before the run ref moves. Because a continued branch descends from a sha that descended from the integration head at attempt N, integration behaves exactly as for any attempt branch; add a replay test where attempt 2 continues attempt 1's sealed work after a failed verification and integrates, and one where attempt 1 sealed nothing and attempt 2 starts from the integration head.

Keep the old attempt worktree retained for inspection as today; only the base of the next attempt changes. Update references/operations.md ('Isolated attempts' and 'Recovery') to describe the continuation rule in two sentences.

Second small change in worktree.mjs while you are there: when the repository root has a node_modules directory, createAttemptWorktree links it into the new worktree as a symlink named node_modules (never copied), so repository-level tests that need installed binaries (test/ci-policy.test.mjs runs the commit-msg hook through commitlint) and `npm run typecheck` work inside an attempt worktree without any install; the snapshot already excludes node_modules at any depth, so confirm with a named test that the symlink is neither captured as an entry nor reported as a symlink escape.

Keep your context small: read by offset or grep, never whole large files. Do not modify .runs/control or .runs/campaigns and do not commit. Writing the canonical result file the controller designates is required.
decisions: Sealed work is never discarded: attempt N+1 continues from attempt N's sealed sha when there is one.
